(Currently Amended) 1) Composition for topical use comprising a) a compound of formula I, wherein the compound of formula I is an indole derivative; b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action.

(Cancelled) 2) Composition according to Claim 1 wherein the compound of formula I is 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof.

(Currently Amended) 3) Composition according to Claim 1, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 percent by weight to 10 percent by weight.

(Currently Amended) 4) Composition according to Claim 1, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 percent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 percent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 percent by weight.

(Currently Amended) 7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition.

(Currently Amended) 8) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for treating skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, in particular for the treatment of acne vulgaris and other defects of keratinisation.

(Currently Amended) 9) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development.

(Currently Amended) 10) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the care, preservation, or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair.

(Currently Amended) 11) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 as a skin lightening and/or skin whitening active agent.

(Currently Amended) 12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening.

(Currently Amended) 13) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin.

(Currently Amended) 14) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced aging processes of the human skin, in particular for prophylaxis against dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the reduction or prevention of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin.
